summary_en: Year-end dividend per share raised by 1.50 yen to 7.00 yen for fiscal year ending December 2026, bringing total annual dividend to 12.50 yen from previous forecast of 11.00 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Q-TRACK ONE announced on November 13, 2026 that it revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The year-end dividend per share has been increased by 1.50 yen to 7.00 yen, raising the total annual dividend from the previously forecasted 11.00 yen to 12.50 yen.

The company identified shareholder profit distribution as a key management priority and stated its basic policy of continuously providing returns to shareholders in line with business performance. Based on this policy, the company decided to enhance shareholder returns by raising the year-end dividend forecast from the previous prediction of 5.50 yen per share.
